_about: Dev Control Tower settings, modelled on skchiew-bot/d3ngineering (sections 12, 17-20, 34, 44-46). Edit here; no code change needed.

stopLoss._about: Section 18. Consecutive failures only; a pass resets them. When a budget is reached the hook tells Claude to stop repeating that approach, record the evidence and tell the owner. Mark a test run expected to fail with DEVLOG_EXPECT_RED=1 in the command.
stopLoss._maxEditsToOneFile: Edits to one file with no passing test or typecheck run in between.

waste._about: Section 19. Signs of effort without progress; the hook warns once per file or command per session.

modelTiers._about: Tiers from the model-selection table in CLAUDE.md, matched against the model id. Premium spend is the high tier.

currency._about: Costs are priced from token counts with `pricing`, in USD. To also show RM, set myrPerUsd to a current rate as a decimal string, with the date and where it came from.

highRiskPaths._about: Section 34.6 Governance. A session that edits any of these is shown as high risk.

pricing._about: USD per million tokens, used to price each session's tokens exactly. Claude Code's own cost figure is shown beside it as a cross-check. Update when prices change; never hardcode them in code.
pricing.source: claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-10-06); cache writes at 1.25x input (5 minutes) and 2x input (1 hour)
pricing.notes: Haiku 5.5 cache read is derived as 0.1x input (not stated in the source). Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens cost more ($0.50 / $2.50); that tier is not modelled. Fast mode is not modelled.

branches._about: Branch and fork audit. Every branch must be part of the plan (named for a plan phase, a PR titled with a phase, or linked to a board task with --branch) or it is reported as a fork. Plan phases come from src/progress.ts.
